changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A script run can stop because code decided without evidence that it asked for and did not get.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE review_job_script_run DROP CONSTRAINT ck_review_job_script_run_reason

ALTER TABLE review_job_script_run ADD CONSTRAINT ck_review_job_script_run_reason CHECK (stop_reason IS NULL OR stop_reason IN ('UNAVAILABLE','BUDGET','DEADLINE','TOO_LARGE','OFF_FORMAT','REFUSED','ERROR','CANCELLED','INVALID_SCRIPT','INVALID_CANDIDATE','UNREAD_EVIDENCE'))

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE review_job_script_run DROP CONSTRAINT ck_review_job_script_run_reason
